correctness.rationale: The derived ideal is the exterior square, so bracket preservation forces the central diagonal block to be the exterior square of the induced G. Squaring gives G²=I and fG+Qf=0. In characteristic not two, the allowed f change sign between the source and target eigenspaces, giving a·ab+b·(choose(a,2)+choose(b,2)). The shear h=−fG/2 has hG=−f/2 and Qh=f/2, killing f. Counting complements gives q^(ab); minimizing a²−(d−1)a+d(d−1)/2 gives the stated integer minimum and equality cases, including d=2. In characteristic two the shift on J₂⊗J₂ has independent images x⊗x and x⊗u+u⊗x+x⊗x with (G−I)u=x; its rank is exactly two since its square is zero. Exterior squares of individual length-two blocks are trivial. The resulting Jordan multiplicities and Hom dimensions give E, and choosing im N, ker N and V/ker N ≅ im N gives the three factors for quotient maps, including the r=0 shear stratum. Independent direct G enumeration and kernel ranks match all six table totals (10, 1184, 19357696, 46, 176, 57592); replay with node /workspace/review-evidence/bounded-checks.js. The checks do not cover extension fields or prove conjugacy; those conclusions follow from the proof.

originality.rationale: The frozen combined finding presents exact odd-characteristic finite-field counts and the conjugacy classification without crediting the earlier Resultary theorem giving the same strata and class sizes. Its split representative also immediately gives the fixed-space profile and hence the sharp minimum. Extending the same shear argument to arbitrary fields of characteristic not two and including d=2 does not remove this substantial coverage. The characteristic-two rank-stratified census survives the comparison, but no narrowed replacement is delivered; this is rejection of the frozen originality claim, not a disproof of its mathematics.

It stratifies all square-one lifts by the rank of the quotient shift and captures the central shears absent in the semisimple treatment.
